cohort: 100 neonates with culture-positive sepsis admitted to the Department of Paediatrics, Government Medical College, Bettiah, West Champaran, Bihar, India from December 2018 to July 2019.
finding: Thrombocytopenia is a frequent occurrence in neonates with sepsis, especially with Gram-negative organisms.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery (NVD) was the mode of delivery in 69% of neonates.
